raw_text: IT EN DE MENU HOME / PROPERTIES / TRILOCALE ZONA CENTRALE A FOSSALTA DI PIAVE FOR SALE · APARTMENT Trilocale Zona Centrale a Fossalta di Piave FOSSALTA DI PIAVE - CENTRO · FOSSALTA DI PIAVE · VENEZIA PRICE €163,000 Photos (11) Floor plans (1) 1 / 11 FLOOR AREA 90 m² BEDROOMS 2 BATHROOMS 1 LIFT No ENERGY CLASS In definizione Overview Welcome to your new home in Fossalta di Piave! In the heart of Fossalta di Piave, just steps away from all main services but set in a quiet and private context, we offer for sale a bright three-room apartment located on the first floor. The apartment stands out for its practical and well-organized internal layout. Crossing the threshold, you are welcomed by a comfortable entrance hallway that harmoniously distributes all areas of the house. On one side is the cozy open-plan living area with a living room and kitchenette, accompanied by a convenient windowed bathroom. On the other side, an hallway leads to the sleeping area, consisting of a spacious master bedroom and a versatile second bedroom, perfect as a children's room, study or guest room. The true added value of this property is the outdoor space: a portion of private garden within the green condominium setting, an ideal corner to relax outdoors, enjoy moments with company or let children play safely. The property also includes a convenient private garage. It’s the perfect solution for young couples, families or anyone looking for convenience in town without giving up their own garden privacy. A home ready to welcome you and provide maximum comfort!
